agent-design-advisor v1.0.0

- Initial release of the agent-design-advisor skill.
- Evaluates whether a workflow is suitable for AI Agent implementation based on three key criteria.
- Provides structured design recommendations in five areas when appropriate: model selection, tool definition, instruction configuration, orchestration, and safeguards.
- Outputs clear evaluation results and actionable advice without including any code or specific model names.
- The knowledge source is OpenAI’s “A Practical Guide to Building Agents” (2025-04-07, public).
